chunks: I had no knowledge of the higher Assembly when they discussed it among themselves.

key_terms.الْمَلإِ الْأَعْلَى: The higher Assembly, superior gathering (referring to the angels)
key_terms.يَخْتَصِمُونَ: They dispute or deliberate among themselves

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by the 'higher Assembly' and the Prophet's lack of knowledge about it?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) reliance on divine revelation (wahy) rather than innate knowledge, affirming his status as the chosen recipient of God's message. It connects the celestial debate among the angels to the broader narrative of Adam's creation, illustrating how prophetic knowledge is granted specifically for the purpose of conveying divine truth to humanity.
